subject: Architect Series: Invite seeding, RSVP cadence & venue linking
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-21 09:15 PDT
Subject: Architect Series: invite seeding, RSVP cadence & venue linking

Team — kicking off planning for the "Architect Series: High-throughput LLM serving" webinar (target: Apr 28). Main asks in this thread: final invite copy, seed list segments, tracking link plan, and venue/ops ask for the in-person/virtual hybrid.

Quick background: Orchard Labs (partner) is co-marketing and offering a short product demo during the second half. We have a small on-site audience capacity (60) + open virtual RSVP. Goal = 400 total registrations, 120 live attendees (virtual + in-person).

Proposed timeline (short):
- Mar 24: finalize invite copy + hero image (Marissa)
- Mar 26: seed priority list (Mateo + Vivek)
- Mar 29: send first invite (official)
- Apr 11: Reminder 1 (CTA: add to calendar + speaker highlight)
- Apr 22: Reminder 2 (last chance + venue details)

Specific asks:
- Marissa: please attach latest invite copy and subject-line variants (include 2 CTA placements).
- Mateo: prepare seed segments CSV + initial tracking links (HubSpot UTM matrix).
- Vivek: confirm if we should rotate CTAs by persona (SRE/Platform/ML Eng). If yes, recommend split percentages.
- Tessa: run ops checklist for on-site logistics and provide preferred arrival window for speaker AV check.

I attached a working draft of invite copy and a venue map stub for ops.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
attachments: invite-copy-v2.docx; venue-map.png
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-21 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Architect Series: invite seeding, RSVP cadence & venue linking

Nice — added a few headline variants and a short subject-line A/B pair in invite-copy-v2. Quick notes:

- Hero: use the Orchard Labs co-brand badge top-left and a 2-line subhead emphasizing "predictable latency at scale."
- CTAs: Primary = "Reserve my seat" (top), Secondary = "View agenda & add to calendar" (bottom).
- Persona rotation: I support rotating CTAs by persona; recommended split: 50% ML Eng (demo-first), 30% Platform (cost/latency), 20% Architects (case studies).

Subject-line variants I added (for testing):
1) "How to get consistent LLM latency at scale — Apr 28"
2) "Architect playbook: Serving LLMs with predictable economics — Apr 28"

Attachments: invite-copy-v2.docx (updated with alt subject lines).

Marissa Cole
Director, Demand Gen | Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-21 13:48 PDT
Subject: Re: Architect Series: invite seeding, RSVP cadence & venue linking

Looping in the seed data plan. Attached CSV is a first pass: tracking-links-pt1.csv. Columns: email_segment, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, hubspot_list_id, link_url. Sample rows: "engineers_core, email, invite, architect-series-040528, 4532, https://redwood.com/r/architect?utm..."

Notes:
- Priority seed: existing customers (list: customers_priority), invited partners, top-100 accounts with active model serving spend (CRM filter).
- Secondary seed: engaged trial users + recent sandbox signups (last 90d).
- I recommend staggered sends to avoid throttles: accounts + partners (Mar 29 AM), customers (Mar 29 PM), prospects (Mar 30).

Also: added a HubSpot workflow suggestion for auto-reminders + calendar add conversions. Pasting the tracking link master: https://drive.google.com/file/d/track-master-id (see folder).

Mateo Alvarez
Senior Growth Ops Manager
attachments: tracking-links-pt1.csv
From: Katie Lin <katie@orchard.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: James Taylor <james.taylor@acmeplatform.com>
Date: 2027-03-22 08:11 PDT
Subject: Re: Architect Series: invite seeding, RSVP cadence & venue linking

Thanks for the outline — excited to co-market. A couple of asks from Orchard:

1) Can we add a co-host blurb in the invite (1 sentence) with a link to our demo signup?
2) We'd like the demo slot to be 10 minutes (short), followed by a joint Q&A. Please confirm AV needs for live demo (remote screen share + wired LAN for lower jitter).
3) If possible, send us the invite copy with our logo placement for review by EOD Mar 24.

We're flexible on audience segmentation; we'll push to our list of 8k architects and dev leads the morning of the first send. Re: on-site, Forge's team (events@theforgevenue.com) copied — they can confirm wired connectivity and a preferred setup time.

— Katie
Katie Lin
Head of Partnerships, Orchard Labs
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Katie Lin <katie@orchard.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-23 15:42 PDT
Subject: Re: Architect Series: invite seeding, RSVP cadence & venue linking

Thanks, Katie — we can do the co-host blurb and short demo. Action items and owners below (closing the loop):

- Marissa: integrate co-host blurb + logo placement; share final invite copy by EOD 3/24 (attachment: invite-copy-v2.docx).
- Mateo: finalize seed CSV and push tracking links to the Drive master; implement staggered sends as proposed.
- Vivek: confirm persona split landing page variants and provide 2 CTA rotations by 3/25.
- Tessa: confirm Forge arrival window for AV check (target 2 hours before start); coordinate with events@theforgevenue.com (cc).
- Katie: please share the Orchard logo file and the one-sentence blurb for inclusion.

On AV: Forge confirmed they have wired LAN and an HDMI-to-DisplayPort adapter. Tessa — please confirm if we need a local backup recorder.

I'll assemble the final go/no-go checklist on 3/26 morning and distribute.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
